text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Starting this year, Special Week takes on the challenges of being a senior-year racer. We're going to our first shrine visit of the year when…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh! S-sorry! I was just thinking to myself.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: This is where everyone hangs their hopes and wishes for the year, right?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Like "I'm gonna get first place!" or "I'm winning the Derby!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Or even, "I don't want to lose to my rivals."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: When a racer has someone they don't wanna lose against, it's like a fire starts raging deep inside of them.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I wanna win. In my races and against my rivals.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I wanna win with everything I've got.
choice_data_list: We'll win. We'll do whatever it takes.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Oh! While we're here, why don't we write down our hopes too?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: In other words, pick a goal for me this year!
choice_data_list: To learn a variety of skills!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oooh, I see! My strength, huh? All righty!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Then let's eat at every food stall here today!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: My mom used to say that power comes from food!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: We'll start with some amazake, and then we'll have yakisoba and sweet steamed buns! Oh, and also some takoyaki…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with that, an enthusiastic Special Week and I fill up our bellies.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hmm… Elevate my abilities, huh?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: You got it! All righty, I'll start out with ten sprints up and down the stairs!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whoops! That was a close one. It's pretty dangerous with so many people here right now.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hum… I guess I'll start tonight, then! I'm counting on your wise leadership!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the year gets off to a quick start, courtesy of some training with a highly-motivated Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Skills, huh? Skills… Skills…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh! Yeah, I've got skills! Check this out!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Special Week Rolling Attaaack!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: …How was that?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: It's a combination of a pro-wrestling move that El taught me, along with my name…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As we depart the shrine, I explain to her that her display of wrestling prowess wasn't quite exactly what I had in mind.
